IONIQ 5 

The beauty of electric 
innovation. 
Breathtakingly beautiful and amazingly advanced, the IONIQ 5 continues redefining the way people look  
at electric cars. With its innovative concept car design and an astonishing array of smart tech, it's ready  
to take you farther with ultra-fast charging and sleeker style. 

Car shown not to UK spec. 
Concept car design 
in series. 
The IONIQ 5 showcases a fresh and innovative approach to electric vehicle design, bringing the 
futuristic concept car aesthetic to the UK. This exciting update maintains the original concept's 
essence, with energy in the design. 
The IONIQ 5 showcases a simple and clean design that sets it apart from other electric vehicles.  
The clamshell hood of the car spans the entire width, creating a seamless and high-tech appearance. 
The LED lighting features unique jewel-like design elements called Parametric Pixels, which are present 
in all IONIQ models. 



Live, drive, work, relax. 
With our dedicated electric vehicle platform, we have been able to create an interior that offers 
the best in-car experience, redefining both living space and moving space. 
Inside the IONIQ 5, we have blurred the lines between living space and moving space. Our E-GMP  
platform enables us to completely reimagine the interior. The spacious, flat floor, highly adjustable front 
seats that can be fully reclined, and a sliding centre console that can be moved back and forth, combine  
to create a more relaxed driving experience. 
Car shown not to UK spec. Car shown not to UK spec. 

Feature highlights. 
The IONIQ 5 redefines mobility with its wide array of high-technology convenience features that are as unique as they are smart and a pleasure to use. Additionally, IONIQ 5 supports the electric mobility lifestyle with its innovative V2L function, which lets you freely 
use or charge any electric devices, such as electric bicycles, scooters, or camping equipment while on the move or at a specific location. 
Spacious Interior 
E-GMP allows for unique interior designs in electric vehicles, 
providing a spacious front area by relocating the AC system 
from inside the car to the space freed up by replacing the 
engine with an electric motor. 
12.3 “Touchscreen and 12.3” Instrument panel 
The 12.3” infotainment touchscreen gives you access to all 
settings including connectivity to your phone via Bluetooth, 
or Apple Car Play / Android Auto, giving you control over 
your preferences and customisation of settings. 
Vision Roof 
Create a greater feeling of space and calm from the inside 
and the cool effect of a two tone roof from the outside. 
Digital rear view mirror 
Enjoy perfect rear view visibility even when you’ve got 
luggage blocking the rear window. When activated, the 
Digital Centre Mirror uses a camera to project a 
real-time 
display onto the mirror. 

Connected Car Services.
Experience seamless connectivity with Bluelink®, which turns your compatible smartphone 
into a digital hub for your car. For a decade, you’ll enjoy core features free of charge, including 
Hyundai Digital Key 2

Feature highlights. 
Digital side mirrors 
Enjoy a clear view of what's happening on both  
sides of the vehicle – even in bad weather conditions.  
Digital Side Mirrors give you a wider angle view compared 
to traditional mirrors. 
BOSE premium sound system 
The BOSE® premium sound system delivers stellar 
performance with eight high-performance speakers 
optimally tuned to deliver amazing sound. 
V2L 
With IONIQ 5’s Vehicle-to-Load technology (V2L)  
you can power any device or charge electrical equipment 
up to 3.6kW with the on-board 230V socket. 
Digital Key 
Use your smartphone or digital watch to lock/unlock  
your car, start the engine and even share your digital  
key with friends and family.

Car shown not to UK spec. 

Car shown not to UK spec. 
Camera-based 
monitoring systems 
The updated IONIQ 5 is available with a range of camera-based monitoring systems that give you a better  
view of what’s going on around you in traffic. Enjoy clearer, wider-angle visibility in all kinds of weather with  
Digital Side Mirrors and a Digital Centre Mirror. And for easier and safer parking, the Surround View Monitor  
gives you a bird’s-eye 360-degree view of everything around your vehicle. 
Car shown not to UK spec. 

Distinctive. Iconic. Pure. 
The front. 
The front bumper is defined by a refined V-shape  
incorporating distinctive hidden lights that provide  
an unmistakable light signature. 
The side. 
Taut and perfectly proportioned. The side graphics  
are highlighted by auto-flush door handles that enhance  
the clean look and aerodynamics. 
The evocative design of the redesigned rear bumper and hatch 
harmonises powerfully with the rectangular Parametric Pixels  
rear light signature. 
The rear. 

The N Line and N Line S, 
taking things up a notch. 
Inspired by the award-winning IONIQ 5 N, we have created the exclusive 
IONIQ 5 N Line and N Line S models to capture its thrilling, high-performance 
looks, both inside and out. 
Car shown not to UK spec. 

Living the feeling. 
To enter the N Line cockpit is to feel its motorsport roots instantly. It’s all in the details. From the branded sport seats in luxurious 
materials to the sports-inspired steering wheel. Even the start button and air vents exude the performance feeling. 
The performance inspired sport seats keep you in control and comfortable. They feature the exclusive N Line embossing, red 
contrast stitching and red piping. The N Line Seats are cloth and leather, while N Line S features the upgraded Alcantara seats. 
Intuitive and ergonomic, the redesigned centre console enhances the in-cabin experience by relocating the phone wireless charging 
pad, cupholder and the buttons for seat heating and parking cameras closer to the hand of the driver and passenger.
